name: run-in-tmux-pane
description: Run commands in a temporary tmux pane with full interactive zsh environment (login shell, shims, PATH, aliases, TTY).

interface.shortDescription: Run commands in a temporary tmux pane with full interactive zsh environment (login shell, shims, PATH, aliases, TTY).
interface.longDescription: Runs a command in a temporary tmux pane that has the user's full interactive zsh environment, including login shell, mise/asdf shims, custom PATH entries, aliases, and a real TTY. The pane opens, executes the command, captures the output, and closes automatically. Use this skill when a command requires the interactive shell environment that agent tools cannot provide — for example, commands that rely on autoloaded zsh functions, version manager shims, or tools that detect whether they are running in a TTY.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the run-in-tmux-pane skill for this task.
